question: Could Au K0 remain fixed at 167 GPa while Mo and Pt K0 were free?
trigger: User asked whether the repeated Au K0=167 could reflect a fixed parameter, as in Sakai 2025.

published_evidence.free_mode_au_k0: 167 +/- 3 GPa, without superscript f, under K0 Free for Metals
published_evidence.interpretation: The printed table indicates free Au K0 in the second mode; original code remains unrecovered.

diagnostic_scope: Same 165 rows and 241 unordered pairs; no AN012 or imputed data. Keep all V0 and the MgO reference fixed; fix only Au K0=167 among the metals, with Mo/Pt K0 and all non-MgO K0_prime free, and NaCl/Ne K0 free.

optimizer.initial: Published free-metal vector, with Au K0 removed and reinserted as constant 167 at residual evaluation.
optimizer.implementation: Reuse load_dataset, _pairs, _fit_parameters(free), vinet_pressure; residual deltaP/sqrt(meanP) for Equation 3 or deltaP for unweighted.

conclusion: Neither diagnostic recovers the printed free-mode Au K0_prime=5.84 to displayed precision. This does not prove the authors did or did not apply this constraint; it is not an author-fit reproduction or replacement coefficients.
